description: Like specific comments on TikTok videos. Each item names the video (videoUrl) and the comment by its text and author username (as list_video_comments returns them); an item matching no comment, or several, fails instead of liking another comment. Opening a video page may count as a view.

required.name: selectedListItems
required.description: Items with videoUrl plus the comment's text and username (list_video_comments rows work as-is); an id from list_video_comments (TikTok's own, or a derived tth- id) is matched first

optional.name: maxLikesPerRun
optional.description: Limit: max likes in one run (default 10, hard max 50)

steps.value: Liked comment by {{item.username}} on: {{item.videoUrl or item.url}}
